## Kyoto 5-Day Family Trip Plan
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg

A balanced family itinerary for **2 adults + 1 child (age 8)**, keeping each day temple-light enough for kids, with food-market stops and realistic local spending.
Budget target: **¥180,000 total** excluding international flights.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary and Cost Plan
| Day | Focus | Morning | Afternoon | Kid-friendly activity | Estimated local transport | Estimated meals | Day total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Day 1 — Mar 10 | Higashiyama welcome | Kiyomizu-dera and Sannenzaka stroll | Yasaka Shrine, Gion walk | Tea house sweets break and souvenir stamp hunt | ¥1,500 | ¥10,000 | ¥11,500 |
| Day 2 — Mar 11 | Market + central Kyoto | Nishiki Market breakfast crawl | Kyoto Imperial Palace area | Kyoto Railway Museum or Kyoto Aquarium | ¥2,000 | ¥12,000 | ¥14,000 |
| Day 3 — Mar 12 | Arashiyama nature day | Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji gardens | Togetsukyo Bridge, river area | Monkey Park Iwatayama | ¥3,000 | ¥11,000 | ¥14,000 |
| Day 4 — Mar 13 | Northern temples | Kinkaku-ji early visit | Ryoan-ji, Daitoku-ji area | Kyoto City Zoo or Heian Shrine grounds | ¥2,500 | ¥11,500 | ¥14,000 |
| Day 5 — Mar 14 | East Kyoto + final shopping | Fushimi Inari early hike | Teramachi/Shinkyogoku shopping | Matcha dessert stop and arcade time | ¥2,000 | ¥12,000 | ¥14,000 |

## Kyoto Day Plan With Family-Fit Details
### Day 1: Higashiyama welcome
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Start at **Kiyomizu-dera** early, then walk downhill through **Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka** for classic Kyoto streets.
- **Afternoon:** Visit **Yasaka Shrine** and continue into **Gion** for an easy first-day pace.
- **Food:** Try yuba, croquettes, and wagashi; keep lunch simple near Higashiyama.
- **Kid-friendly activity:** Stamp-collecting and snack stops along the preserved streets.
- **Estimated cost:** Transport **¥1,500**, meals **¥10,000**.

### Day 2: Market + central Kyoto
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/shop.svg
- **Morning:** Breakfast at **Nishiki Market** with small bites so everyone can sample different foods.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Morning:** Breakfast at **Nishiki Market** with small bites so everyone can sample different foods, Kyoto, Japan
- **Afternoon:** Walk the **Kyoto Imperial Palace** area for open space and a calmer pace.
- **Food:** Market snacks, tamagoyaki, tofu treats, and a sit-down noodle lunch.
- **Kid-friendly activity:** Choose **Kyoto Railway Museum** for hands-on exhibits, or **Kyoto Aquarium** if your child prefers animals.
- **Estimated cost:** Transport **¥2,000**, meals **¥12,000**.

### Day 3: Arashiyama nature day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning:** Visit the **Bamboo Grove** and **Tenryu-ji** gardens before crowds build.
- **Afternoon:** Cross **Togetsukyo Bridge** and enjoy the river area.
- **Food:** Lunch around Arashiyama with udon, tofu set meals, or curry rice for a kid-safe option.
- **Kid-friendly activity:** **Monkey Park Iwatayama** for a fun climb and city view.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/ea/Iwatayama_Monkey_Kyoto.jpg Alt=Kid-friendly activity:** **Monkey Park Iwatayama** for a fun climb and city view, Kyoto, Japan
- **Estimated cost:** Transport **¥3,000**, meals **¥11,000**.

### Day 4: Northern temples
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/moon-stars.svg
- **Morning:** Go early to **Kinkaku-ji** for better photos and lighter crowds.
- **Afternoon:** Continue to **Ryoan-ji**; if energy is high, add the **Daitoku-ji** area.
- **Food:** Set lunches near the temple corridor; add a dessert stop afterward.
- **Kid-friendly activity:** **Kyoto City Zoo** is the easiest high-energy option, with **Heian Shrine** grounds as a quieter backup.
- **Estimated cost:** Transport **¥2,500**, meals **¥11,500**.

### Day 5: East Kyoto + final shopping
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- **Morning:** Do **Fushimi Inari Taisha** early, but keep the hike short and family-friendly.
- **Afternoon:** Shop in **Teramachi/Shinkyogoku** for gifts and snacks.
- **Food:** Finish with matcha sweets, ramen, or a tempura lunch.
- **Kid-friendly activity:** Arcade time or a dessert café break after shopping.
- **Estimated cost:** Transport **¥2,000**, meals **¥12,000**.

## Budget Fit for 2 Adults + 1 Child
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/currency-rupee.svg
- **Local transport total:** about **¥11,000**
- **Meals total:** about **¥56,500**
- **Temple/attraction admissions:** about **¥18,000–¥24,000**
- **Snacks, souvenirs, small extras:** about **¥20,000–¥30,000**
- **Suggested lodging allowance:** about **¥70,000–¥85,000** for 4 nights
- **Estimated trip total:** about **¥175,500–¥186,500**

Best fit: if you keep lodging near **¥75,000–¥80,000**, the trip stays comfortably around your **¥180,000** target.
